title: HELIX Govern: Data Classification Handling Rules
description: Specific handling requirements for each HELIX data classification tier. Institutions adopt these as baseline policy and customize as needed.

tiers.definition: Data approved for unrestricted public access.
tiers.examples: Course catalog, institution name, program listings, campus locations

handling.access_control: No restrictions. Available to any authenticated or anonymous user.
handling.sharing: No restrictions. May be published on website, shared freely.
handling.disposal: Standard deletion when no longer needed

tiers.definition: Data intended for institutional use only.
tiers.examples: Enrollment counts (pre-publication), section capacity, course schedules, department budgets, organizational charts

handling.access_control: Role-based. Available to institutional employees with a legitimate business need.
handling.sharing: Internal sharing permitted. External sharing requires approval from Data Steward.

tiers.definition: Data protected by regulation or policy. FERPA-protected student education records fall here at minimum.
tiers.examples: Student PII (name + education record), grades, GPA, admission decisions, donor records, employee performance evaluations

handling.encryption_at_rest: Required (AES-256 or equivalent). Separate encryption keys from public/internal data.
handling.access_control: Role-based with named authorization. Only users with a documented legitimate educational interest (FERPA) or business need.
handling.audit_logging: Required. Log: who accessed, when, what data, from where. Retain logs for 7 years minimum.
handling.data_masking: Required in non-production environments (dev, test, training). PII must be masked or synthetic.
handling.retention: Per FERPA (education records retained as long as institution exists) and institutional schedule. Minimum 5 years after last enrollment for student records.
handling.sharing: External sharing requires: (a) Data Sharing Agreement, (b) Data Steward approval, (c) FERPA-compliant authorization (consent or exception). Internal sharing limited to authorized roles.
handling.disposal: Secure deletion with certificate of destruction. Crypto-shred encrypted data.

ferpa_specific.directory_information: Check FERPA restriction flags (HELIX Hold, type: ferpa) before any disclosure of directory information
ferpa_specific.legitimate_educational_interest: Document in role definitions which data each role needs and why
ferpa_specific.annual_notification: Institution must annually notify students of their FERPA rights
ferpa_specific.third_party_disclosure: Requires written consent OR a FERPA exception (health/safety emergency, judicial order, financial aid audit, authorized research, etc.)

tiers.definition: Highly sensitive data requiring the strictest access controls. GLBA-covered customer financial information falls here.
tiers.examples: SSN, bank account numbers, FAFSA/ISIR data, EFC/SAI, tax return information, health records (if not covered by HIPAA), disciplinary records

handling.encryption_at_rest: Required (AES-256). Dedicated KMS keys separate from confidential data. Column-level encryption for the most sensitive fields (SSN, bank accounts).
handling.access_control: Named individual authorization. No group/role grants. Each person accessing restricted data must be individually approved by the Data Trustee or designee.
handling.mfa: Required. Hardware token or phishing-resistant MFA preferred.
handling.audit_logging: Required. Enhanced logging: log query text in addition to access metadata. Real-time alerting on anomalous access patterns. Retain logs for 7+ years.
handling.data_masking: Required everywhere except the specific production process that needs the raw value. SSN: display only last 4 in all UIs. Bank accounts: never display.
handling.tokenization: Required for SSN and bank account numbers. Replace with tokens in all layers above bronze. Original values retained only in encrypted bronze with audit-logged access.
handling.retention: Per GLBA (as long as customer relationship + 5 years), FERPA, and institutional schedule. ISIR data: retain for 3 years after end of award year per federal regulation.
handling.sharing: External sharing requires: (a) Formal Data Sharing Agreement with GLBA provisions, (b) Data Trustee approval, (c) Legal/compliance review. No self-service access.
handling.disposal: Crypto-shred with certificate of destruction. Verify destruction across all copies including backups.
handling.incident_response: Any unauthorized access or breach must be reported to the GLBA coordinator and institution's incident response team within 24 hours

glba_specific.safeguards_rule: Designate a GLBA coordinator. Conduct annual risk assessment. Implement safeguards. Oversee service providers. Evaluate and adjust.
glba_specific.service_providers: Any third-party with access to restricted financial data must have a contract with GLBA safeguards provisions
glba_specific.ftc_rule: FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR 314) requires documented information security program for customer financial information
